title: AION 2 Ranger: Leveling Build and Skills
description: Build a Ranger with MP recovery, Snipe and Deadshot options, critical follow-ups, and Daevanion priorities.
summary: Keep ranged attacks sustainable, select the specializations you unlock, and upgrade the skills your current build actually uses.
quickAnswer: TW starter PvE: Select MP recovery on your ordinary attack, prepare main ranged attacks, and keep movement or defense reachable. The Snipe–Deadshot cooldown interaction requires its selected specialization; use the ordinary cooldown until it is unlocked.
